configurations.name: site
runtimeArgs: cd site && if [ -f ../examples/starter/.env ]; then set -a; . ../examples/starter/.env; set +a; fi && export ASKDARE_GALLERY=${ASKDARE_GALLERY:-1} ASKDARE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${ASKDARE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-http://127.0.0.1:4000} && exec ./node_modules/.bin/next dev --port 3000

configurations.name: starter
runtimeArgs: cd examples/starter && { grep -q '^ASKDARE_MODEL=.' .env .env.local 2>/dev/null || export ASKDARE_MODEL=gpt-6.1-terra; } && exec ./node_modules/.bin/next dev --port 3001
